'''Herglic Space''' was located in the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] around the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], a territory founded by the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] before the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It contained the planet [[Giju/Legends|Giju]] and some 40 other star systems.

The Herglic Space was the remnant of an ancient trade empire ruled by the Herglics. That empire once included a territory of much of what would be called the Colonies, and the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. Eventually the empire collapsed, leaving only its core with Giju and other systems around the Rimma (a branch of the ancient [[Hidakai Pool]]). A millennium after that collapse, the Herglics allied with the Republic. Herglic populations however continued to be found all along the Rimma.<ref name="TEA" />

The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to nationalize its manufacturing centers shortly before the [[Declaration of a New Order]]; a brief uprising was suppressed before it was named an [[Allied Region]]. Eventually, Herglic Space aligned with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]].<ref name="TEA" />
